title: Meseriasi MCP Server
description: MCP server for meseriasi.ro, a Romanian homeowner-tradesperson marketplace.
summary: MCP server for meseriasi.ro, a Romanian homeowner-tradesperson marketplace.
offersHint: MCP server for meseriasi.ro, a Romanian homeowner-tradesperson marketplace. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.meseriasi.ro/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_tradespeople
toolsPreview.description: Search for tradespeople on meseriasi.ro by location and/or category (trade type). Returns a paginated list of matching profiles.

toolsPreview.name: get_tradesperson_profile
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the full profile of a tradesperson by their UUID (or legacy WordPress integer ID). Includes bio, location, trade type, and bid statistics.

toolsPreview.name: request_chat_otp
toolsPreview.description: Send a one-time password (OTP) to the user's email so they can verify their identity before starting a conversation with a tradesperson. Call this first, then call start_conversation with the OTP the user receives.

toolsPreview.name: start_conversation
toolsPreview.description: Verify the OTP sent to the user's email and start a direct conversation with a tradesperson. Creates a homeowner account automatically if the email is new.

toolsPreview.name: create_project
toolsPreview.description: Create a new project on meseriasi.ro as a homeowner. Notifies nearby tradespeople automatically. Requires the caller to supply a valid Supabase access token in the "access_token" argument.
